fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of arcane locusts that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Ravening Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends a swarm of arcana into the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Blight Chorus
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to conjure a swarm of arcane locusts for 12 seconds. It devours enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.

fusions.name: Gorged on Arcana
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
